title: [Decision] Should an administrator be able to send an in-app message to everyone in their organization, or to a chosen set of users, from the console?
body:
triage#1 · baozhoutao · session_01RKKVnggJeBxtQEF8sbEJAW

Filing category: ② a decision only the maintainer can make (a new capability with a permission model).

## 维护者速读

- 现象：控制台里没有「发站内信」的入口。唯一能发的路是作者自己搭 screen flow + `notify` 节点；「指定几个用户」这样能做，但「本组织全体成员」没有对应的收件人写法，只能把 `role:owner` / `role:admin` / `role:delegated_admin` / `role:member` 全列上——角色为空的成员、自定义角色的成员会漏掉，每个角色超过 10000 人会被静默截断。
- 要你裁：是否提供「管理员在界面上给本组织全体 / 指定用户发站内信」，以及做到哪一层。
- 推荐：A：新增收件人写法「本组织全体成员」+ Setup 里一个只给管理员的「发送站内信」动作，统一走 `emit()`。

## One-sentence problem

An organization administrator who needs to tell every member something (a policy change, a maintenance window) has no way to do it from the console, and the only author-side workaround silently misses members.

## Evidence

- Audience selectors (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts`): user id, email, `role:<name>` (`sys_member.role`, organization-scoped), `team:<id>`, `owner_of:<obj>:<id>`. No selector means "every member of this organization".
- `sys_member.role` is `required: false` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-member.object.ts`), so a member with no role matches no `role:` selector; `resolveRole` reads with `limit: 10000` and does not report a truncation.
- No compose surface: the `/notifications` HTTP domain is the caller's own inbox only (list / read / devices); the only "New" in the console is the generic `sys_inbox_message` form, which is a defect filed as #32444 (it bypasses `emit()`).
- Already possible today, for the record: a specific set of users — a screen flow whose `notify.recipients` is a list of user ids / emails or a CEL list from a multi-user field.

## Governing text

- ADR-0030: single ingress `emit({ topic, audience, … })`; L3 resolves "the producer's explicit audience (`role:` / `owner_of:record` / `team:` / explicit ids …)".
- ADR-0030 status line, amendment 2026-10-20 (ruling D on #24770): "a topic-subscription capability, if real demand appears, returns as a new decision with a who-may-subscribe-whom permission model." — an organization-wide send needs the same kind of "who may message whom" answer.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What the customer sees | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | New audience selector "every member of the emitting organization" (paged, no silent cap) **and** a Setup action "Send in-app message": multi-user picker or an "everyone in this organization" switch, title / body / severity / link, organization administrators only, calls `emit()` | An admin sends an announcement from Setup in one dialog; it appears in every member's bell and can be marked read | server lane · 2 PRs (selector; Setup action + permission) · no precedent measured |
| B | Selector only; no console surface | Possible, but only by building a screen flow in Studio | server lane · 1 small PR · no precedent measured |
| C | Neither; document the role-list recipe | Admins keep missing members with no role or a custom role | docs only |

Business reading: A = an "announcements" button like most SaaS admin consoles have; B = a building block for app authors, not for admins; C = organization-wide messaging is out of scope.

## Recommendation

A. Two years out, an administrator expects to reach their whole organization from the admin console (Feishu / DingTalk admin announcements, Microsoft 365 message center, Slack workspace announcements), and the platform already has the delivery half (single ingress, inbox, receipts, push); only the audience and the entry point are missing. Phase it: the selector first (it also makes flows reliable), then the Setup action. Not B: it leaves the requested user (an admin, not an author) without the capability. Not C: the recipe is lossy by construction. Confidence gap: abuse limits for very large organizations (fan-out rate, a per-organization daily cap) are unmeasured.
Self-check: only ① picks A; ②③④ do not flip it (④ only argues for the phasing).

## After the ruling

A: (1) server seat — the selector in `RecipientResolver`, paged over `sys_member` of the emitting organization, a logged count instead of a silent cap, tests including members with no role; (2) server + ui seats — a Setup action backed by an `api`/`flow` action that calls `emit()` as the acting admin, gated to organization admins, with a confirmation that shows the recipient count. The generic inbox New form is closed by #32444.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 只加一个收件人写法和一个管理入口，复用 emit() 单入口，不新增投递路径；C 让每个应用各自拼角色清单。
② 实际业务拉动: 维护者本次直接提出（2026-11-11 会话：「是否支持通过UI给全组织下的所有成员统一发站内信」）；任何组织公告场景都会撞上。
③ 防 AI 犯错: 一个闭合的「本组织全体」写法优于让作者或 agent 手列角色（漏人是静默的）；发送前显示收件人数是响亮确认。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: B 最小；A 的 Setup 动作是一个新的永久界面义务，建议分两期。
